_about: How rooms look in 3D, by hand, where room_looks.py's reading of their words falls short (src/room_looks.py). 'rooms' pins one room's look; 'zones' gives a zone's look to its rooms that have none of their own (underground looks only to enclosed rooms that don't read as a building's, outdoor looks only to open country). Looks: cave, mine, crypt, sewer, dungeon, desert, snow, shore, volcanic, swamp, stones, village, camp, garden, ruins, terrace, ice_cave, lava_cave. 'interiors' gives a zone's indoor rooms a style (castle, arcane, holy, infernal, haunted, dwarven, elven: world3d/terrain-interiors.js). Give each entry its reason in '_why'.
